scope: Three complete individual cards and directly affected damage/prevention interactions. No aggregate validation or full-set acceptance.

sources.scoped_utility: Complete CardUtil overflowInc, overflowMultiply and overflowResult methods only; broad retained file not claimed fully read.
sources.intentional_java_discrepancy: Oracle damage plus X uses current signed power inside a calculation; CR107.1b clamps only final negative damage. Implementmax(0,originalDamage+signedPower). XMage NOT_NEGATIVE clamps intermediate power, intentionally not copied. This is a rules inference from primary wording, not an explicit negative-Hawkeye ruling.

implementation.Hawkeye: Noncombat damage from its current controller to an opponent or their current permanent receives signed current provider power, clamped only after addition; each exact provider applies once per event. Frozen damage actor/keywords retain ordinary lifelink/LKI semantics.
implementation.Wolverine: Optional other-creature entry fight. Before the final simultaneous damage batch, remove old marked damage from each exact pending heal recipient once. Preserve the entire new batch and damage/deathtouch history. Heal is a replacement, not prevention.
implementation.Mjolnir: Optional entry4damage; equip1 only current own legendary non-Villain red/white creatures. Other attachment abilities bypass worthiness. Every exact equipped creature damage source doubles, including combat after assignment and noncombat. Hand channel2R pays actual discard and deals2 to all creatures.
implementation.intrinsic_prevention_order: Existing keyword protection and combat-prevention effects participate in the ordered damage loop alongside printed replacements. New typed intrinsic prevention choices have no invented printed ability indices. Prevention first can make healing inapplicable; healing first remains queued if the later damage portion is prevented.
implementation.ownership: DamageBatch owns exact pending heal refs, counted in state_bytes and cloned/restored with pending choices.
implementation.compatibility: New view vectors omitted when empty. Existing printed replacement action and old policy scores retained; new intrinsic choice uses analogous score120.
